abi.name: boa_protocol
abi.version_domain: wire ABI domain; independent of the pipeline_validator software artifact schema/ABI (currently 6/v6 after the P08 cutover); no automatic fallback between the two domains
abi.numeric_reference: hardware/boa/reference/numeric_freeze.md (P03; brought in by reference, not re-frozen here)

frame.note: magic 'BP', version byte, kind byte, payload byte length, then payload; decoders reject unknown version, unknown kind, truncated payload and trailing bytes inside one frame

AccFormat.note: V1 AM always carries f32 partial sums (bf16_fp32_mac_rne_v1); new formats are a schema version bump, not a silent value

Transpose.note: tn = transpose_a (A stored [K,m]), nt = transpose_b (B stored [n,K]); per-step descriptor state, never chain state

AmError.source_of_truth: pipeline_validator/runtime/shared_am.py::request permanent errors; closed enum, unknown values are decode errors

FieldTag.note: machine-readable error attribution: every rejection names a field

EventToken.note: Static event slot identity allocated at context admission.

ClipPair.note: Raw FP32 clip bounds; not NaN, lo <= hi as FP32 values.

EpilogueConfig.note: FINAL-only post-processing block (P03 section 4, P08 production contract); order bias -> scale -> ReLU -> clip -> convert is frozen by reference in numeric_freeze.md.  Fixed wire layout: n_cols (u16), enables (u8 presence bits bias=0/scale=1/relu=2/clip=3/quant=4, bits 5..7 reserved zero), then the n_cols bias words, scale, clip lo/hi and quant inv_scale+zero_point.  Stage presence is explicit (enables on the wire, a dedicated bias_present/scale_present/clip_present/quant_present field in the decoded codecs); it never derives from the value representation, so a present-empty stage (n_cols=0, bias enabled) survives decode/re-encode byte-identically.  A disabled stage executes nothing (no identity op) and serializes canonical zeros, and decoders reject non-zero disabled stages, so the encoding is canonical and round-trips byte-identically

implicit_fields.name: enables
implicit_fields.note: u8; stages declare presence = enable_bit, the generator emits an explicit bias_present/scale_present/clip_present/quant_present flag set from the decoded enable bit and read back by encode; presence never derives from the value representation (None/empty/NULL items), so present-empty stages (n_cols=0 with bias enabled) round-trip byte-identically

OperandView.note: Typed input view with serialized byte count. allocation is the runtime-bound L1 allocation identity (slot index of the view base); generation is the arena allocation_generation the runtime stamped on the bound AllocationHandle at ALLOC_L1, so a reused allocation across dispatches carries a different generation.

fields.name: generation
fields.note: arena allocation generation bound at ALLOC_L1

fields.name: allocation
fields.note: L1 allocation slot of the referenced view

AM_REQUEST.contract: issued exactly once per allocation; GRANTED | PARKED(later exactly one WAKE) | ERROR(permanent, context faults, never parks)

fields.name: request_seq
fields.note: replay protection key together with owner

fields.name: bundle_slots
fields.note: compiler-written Tile Program metadata; upper bound == capacities.am_slots_per_context

fields.name: byte_count
fields.note: upper bound == capacities.am_slot_capacity_bytes default; runtime rejects against the configured capacity

AM_GRANTED.contract: grant linearization point atomically acquires the granted resource manifest below; affinity fixed until slot_free

fields.name: completion_token
fields.note: reference to the chain completion event; NOT a granted resource, never waited on to grant

AM_PARKED.contract: no slot/quota/generation side effect; exactly one WAKE or one cancel later

AM_ERROR.contract: permanent contract error; the owner context faults; never parks

AM_WAKE.contract: delivers an already-granted lease exactly once per parked request; not a retry permission

AM_CANCEL.contract: drop the owner's parked request (never woken) and reclaim the owner's leases

SUBMIT_STEP.contract: one typed Matmul step; ACCEPTED snapshots the descriptor, FULL changes no state, ERROR names the field

fields.name: seq
fields.note: 0-contiguous; INIT iff seq==0; FINAL at most once, closes new-step admission

fields.name: transpose
fields.note: typed per-step field (P08); storage_k is derived from the stored shapes

fields.name: input_ready_tokens
fields.note: must correspond to already-ready inputs or accepted producer operations

fields.name: input_usage_handles
fields.note: one typed AllocationRef per operand view: a reference to the runtime-bound allocation and its generation (AllocationHandle stamped at ALLOC_L1), released at the step's completion boundary; ordinary reader references are aggregated by the device

fields.name: k_mask
fields.note: storage_k-length activity mask, one byte per lane

fields.name: completion_event
fields.note: static event slot this step signals; program-static, compiler-written

STEP_FULL.contract: mailbox/result-credit shortage; zero state change; UCE parks the context in WAIT_ENGINE_QUEUE and resubmits the same step

EVT_STATUS.contract: level, non-destructive read of per-context wake/event ready bitmaps of this hart

EVT_TAKE.contract: destructive take of one wake record or one event slot's step/chain terminal; sticky until taken

REC_REAP.contract: retire one observed event slot; optional (auto at context retirement); never affects AM resources

CTX_CANCEL.contract: fault/reset/rebind: cancel parked request, quiesce and reclaim the owner's leases, publish failure terminal

MEM_REQ.contract: real participation in L1 arbitration; accepting a command never substitutes the data transfer

MEM_RESP.contract: old responses must never pollute a new generation

descriptor_groups.note: design 4.2 five field groups; every group must be covered by serialized message/struct fields (lint typed_fields_serialized)

internal_state.maintained_by: device; the compiler never guesses these

ctx_key.scope: physical Compute Tile; cross-tile messages also carry tile_id
ctx_key.not: never conflated with TaskIdentity (Grid/Task), physical slot, or engine

lease_handle.note: opaque (entry, generation) pair; slot_generation is per physical slot

event_token.note: event slots allocated at context admission from the Tile Program static event count; content associates handle/generation/seq/kind

logical_am.note: software-selected logical position, not a physical slot

grant.linearization: one serialization point checks grantability, selects the (group,index)-first free slot, takes the ChainTable entry, one next-step mailbox, binds the admitted L1 output destination, sets owner/generation/immutable bound_engine, registers the bundle on the first lease; never returns a handle before the resources are held

preconditions.note: first lease registers the owner bundle; a reservation, not a physical resource

completion_token.refers_to: static event slot identity (ctx_id, ctx_epoch, event_id) allocated at context admission
completion_token.note: AM grant never acquires, waits on, or is blocked by any event slot; old-chain events not yet awaited/reaped never block a new grant of the same logical_am (Q09)

rules: a replayed AM_REQUEST returns the same result and never grants twice
each owner has at most one parked request at a time
the interconnect must not duplicate AM_REQUEST; deduplication behavior is accepted at P14

am_group_count.unit: AM groups per Tile (pure physical slot addressing; neither engine nor L2 Tile Group)

am_slots_per_context.note: hard constraint; counted across all engines of the Tile; V1 forbids raising it

am_slot_capacity_bytes.note: software default 256 KiB f32; typed fixture 64 KiB; effective lower bound 1024 bytes (16x16 f32); physical macro frozen later by SRAM profile
am_slot_capacity_bytes.frozen: candidate; value is the software model default, physical capacity owner is the SRAM profile task

contexts_per_tile.note: default 4; acceptance covers 1/2/4/8; a hart is not a context; AM slots are never permanently partitioned by context count

pending_request_fifo_depth.note: pending queue depth equals the per-Tile context count; at most one parked request per owner; cannot overflow, no BUSY needed

next_step_mailboxes_per_live_chain.note: one next-step mailbox plus one current execution record per live chain; no unbounded step queue

terminal_ring.policy: bounded diagnostic ring; overwrite oldest and count overflow when full; never carries correctness

event_slots.note: event slot count is the Tile Program's static event count, allocated at context admission; not a global constant

engines_per_tile.note: software default 1 (V1 multi-array target 4, exploration cap MAX_BOA_ENGINES=8); engine id domain independent of AM group id domain
engines_per_tile.frozen: candidate; physical engine count frozen by the array tasks

result_fifo_depth.unit: per-engine result FIFO entries, hardware microblock granularity

am_credit_capacity.unit: O/R credits per engine (A/B reads + AM RMW writeback), hardware microblock granularity

software_step_timing.unit: software step-granularity cycles (BoaResultService); hardware microblock timing is a separate domain and the two are compared per-unit, never forced equal

slot_generation.rule: monotonic per physical slot, incremented at each grant
slot_generation.quiescence: wrap 0xffff->0 only when the Tile AM pool has no live lease, no pending request and no in-flight access of any earlier generation

ctx_epoch.rule: incremented at context retirement; reuse only after commands, input references, AM accesses and event references are all safely closed
ctx_epoch.quiescence: wrap 0xff->0 additionally requires context-id quiescence (no outstanding event token of any epoch)

request_seq.rule: per-owner monotonic; (owner, request_seq) unique; replay returns the same result
request_seq.quiescence: wrap requires owner quiescence: no parked request and no live lease

lease_handle.rule: allocator counter; opaque (entry, generation) pair identity

step_seq.rule: 0-contiguous per chain; NO wraparound: a chain longer than 65534 steps is a contract error (STEP_ERROR seq_invalid)

mem_req_id.rule: monotonic request id per memory service
mem_req_id.quiescence: wrap requires memory-service quiescence (no outstanding MEM_REQ); old responses never pollute a new generation

wraparound.no_width_escape: large widths never substitute a wraparound/quiescence rule

freeze.origin: widths below are candidates derived from the section 6.1 capacity domains and frozen by the P10 review; the original design did NOT give them (design 2.2: ID/register/event widths are frozen by a later spec, which is this schema)

tile_id.rationale: 4-Tile software Group, 1-Tile FPGA V1; 16 values headroom

ctx_epoch.rationale: epoch churn is per retirement; wrap rule above

logical_am.rationale: two logical AM positions per context

request_seq.rationale: per-owner request volume; wrap under owner quiescence

request_id.rationale: per-Tile pending queue is bounded by context count

lease_handle.rationale: lease churn bounded by chain count; wrap rule above

event_id.rationale: static per Tile Program event count

seq.rationale: step index; wrap forbidden by contract

byte_count.rationale: slot capacity up to 256 KiB with headroom

not_frozen_here: NaN/INT8 numeric encodings (P03 numeric_freeze.md, by reference)
physical SRAM/bank/adder/drain service capacities (SRAM profile / PPA tasks)
hardware microblock FIFO/credit depths (P16; see capacities reserved entries)

encoding_slots.note: the design section 4.5 'opcode/funct frozen by a later spec' resolves to these reserved slots plus the P21 freeze action; a slot is NOT a frozen encoding
constraints: opcode must come from the RoCC custom-0..3 funct3 space
funct7 values must be unique per instruction and frozen only by P21 with review evidence
downstream tasks must not treat any slot as a frozen encoding before P21

P18: single-array top integration consumes the generated codecs only
P20: generated Python codec for backend wiring

lint.note: executable in hardware/boa/protocol/gen_protocol.py::lint_schema; the check target runs it on the committed schema and on negative fixtures.  epilogue_presence_enable_bit: every enable-bit stage declares presence = enable_bit and each codec carries an explicit presence flag set from the decoded enables byte; no_presence_by_emptiness: a full-codec audit found no presence semantics outside the epilogue enables block (per-message count_field/count_expr lists encode by length with no enable bit; booleans are bool8; AM_ERROR.field uses the field_tag_none sentinel), so presence can never derive from emptiness and no additional generator representation exists
